headline: Bank of Industry Secures $50 Million IFC Loan for Nigerian MSMEs
summary: The Bank of Industry has signed a $50 million loan agreement with the International Finance Corporation to expand long-term financing for Nigerian micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises.
why: IFC financing is a key indicator of institutional support for private sector development in emerging markets, aimed at fostering growth in the SME segment.

impacts.name: Nigerian MSMEs
impacts.why: Increased availability of long-term financing supports business expansion and operational stability.
